title: I sent this back for a refund because the holes in the curved base were too small for the dowels provided
text:
I sent this back for a refund because the holes in the curved base were too small for the dowels provided. My boyfriend has a kneeling chair and I love it. I could not find the one he has so I decided to order this. Based on the look of the parts, the chair would probably have been a good one. However, the holes in the curved rocker part are too small to fit the dowels provided. I'm not interested in having to do woodworking to make the holes bigger so I returned this for a refund.

I probably would have liked or loved this chair otherwise. The instructions were pretty simple to me as I have assembled a lot of furniture before. In fact, I probably could have assembled it in 30 minutes. I already worked on it for 10 minutes when it came time to insert the dowels into the curved based. It was at that point I took it apart to send it back.

product_metadata.title: Sleekform Austin Kneeling Chair - Home Office Ergonomic Computer Desk Stool For Active Sitting
features: [REDUCE PAIN] The Austin positions you with an open hip angle that effortlessly encourages an active upright posture. Kneel position will align your back, shoulders and neck, lower risk of injury. Improves and corrects posture, reminds you to stop slouching.
[DURABILITY] The Austin features a 4” thick seat and comfy memory foam knee cushions, 3 wood cross bars instead of one; and reinforced 20 ply instead of 14 ply birchwood for strength and durability.
[CAPACITY] It has a weight capacity of 120 kgs (almost 265 pounds). Heavy-duty ergo angled cushions for lumbar. Perfect for anyone 5'2"-6'6", works for standard 29” table height.

[VERSATILE] The Austin is a perfect posture corrector for meditation, study, writing, computer work, gaming, a sewing or crafting chair or a posture correcting chair. Supporting muscles and relaxing backaches through alignment correction.
[ROCKING] The rocking movement helps with recovery, increased blood flow, energy and helps maintain focus. The balance and rocking makes sitting comfortable while you work.
